description: This PHP class represents the data transfer object (DTO) LeaveRequestDatesDetail, encapsulating details related to leave request dates including start and end dates, times, and duration info within the OrangeHRM leave plugin.

classes.name: LeaveRequestDatesDetail
classes.description: A DTO class for representing detailed leave request date information including start/end dates, duration type, and times.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new instance with fromDate and optional toDate.

methods.name: getFromDate
methods.description: Returns the start date of the leave request.

methods.name: setFromDate
methods.description: Sets the start date of the leave request.

methods.name: getToDate
methods.description: Returns the end date of the leave request, if set.

methods.name: setToDate
methods.description: Sets the end date of the leave request.

methods.name: getDurationTypeId
methods.description: Returns the ID representing the duration type.

methods.name: setDurationTypeId
methods.description: Sets the ID representing the duration type.

methods.name: getDurationType
methods.description: Returns the string description of the duration type.

methods.name: setDurationType
methods.description: Sets the string description of the duration type.

methods.name: getStartTime
methods.description: Returns the start time for the leave.

methods.name: setStartTime
methods.description: Sets the start time for the leave.

methods.name: getEndTime
methods.description: Returns the end time for the leave.

methods.name: setEndTime
methods.description: Sets the end time for the leave.
